About.title: About Family Recipes
About.intro: Family Recipes keeps the family's recipes in one book everyone opens from the same link. It is free, has no sign-up and is open source.

access.title: Who can see the book
access.p1: The book link is the key: anyone with it can read, add and edit recipes, like a notebook left on the kitchen table. Send the link only to family.
access.p2: Deleted recipes go to the trash and can be restored for 30 days, so mistakes can be undone.

safety.title: How to tell it's safe
safety.p1: Family Recipes never asks for a password, verification code, phone number, ID, card or payment details. If a page asks for that, it is not Family Recipes.

who.title: Who makes it
who.p1: Family Recipes is an independent project, made in Brazil and run by {operator}, the people behind QuemLeva and AmigoSecreto.

code.title: Open source
code.p1: The code is open, under the AGPL-3.0 license, and anyone can check how it works <repo>on GitHub</repo>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain words, what Family Recipes keeps, why and for how long. There is no sign-up, and we don't sell or share data for advertising.

collect.title: What we keep
collect.p1: The book's name and the recipes the family writes: name, whose recipe it is, category, ingredients, method and tips.
collect.p2: A random code for the device, which recognizes you without an account.
collect.p3: To prevent abuse, we log book creation with a scrambled (hashed) version of the IP address. That log is deleted within 1 day.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.p1: Anyone with the book link sees every recipe and can add, edit or move recipes to the trash. The link preview (on WhatsApp, for example) shows only the book's name and how many recipes it has.

device.title: On your device
device.p1: The browser keeps the device code, the "My books" list, your text size, whether you dismissed the pin-to-home-screen card and a cookie with your language. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

providers.title: Services we use
providers.p1: Supabase (database, servers in São Paulo) and Vercel (website hosting). They handle data only so Family Recipes works and may keep technical access logs, such as the IP address, under their own policies.

retention.title: How long
retention.p1: Books are kept while Family Recipes is online, so links keep working. Deleted recipes leave the trash after 30 days. You can ask us to delete a book through the contact below.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: Under Brazil's LGPD, you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or a whole book. Write to the contact below and include the book link.

controller.title: Controller
controller.p1: The data controller is {operator}. If this policy changes, the date at the top is updated.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using Family Recipes, you agree to these terms.

service.title: The service
service.p1: Family Recipes is free and provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always work or be error-free. It may change or shut down; whenever possible, we will warn you first.

content.title: What you write
content.p1: You are responsible for what you write in the book. Don't use Family Recipes for illegal, offensive or misleading content, or for spam. We may remove books that break these rules.
content.p2: Your family's recipes remain your family's.

links.title: Links
links.p1: Anyone with the book link can see and change the recipes. Send the link only to people you trust.

license.title: Open source
license.p1: The Family Recipes code is under the AGPL-3.0 license.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These terms follow the laws of Brazil.

Install.title: Pin to your home screen
Install.body: The book gets an icon next to your other apps and opens straight to the recipes, no need to look for the link.
Install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in the browser bar.
Install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
Install.iosStep3: Tap Add. Done: the book shows up with your other apps.
Install.menuStep1: Tap the ⋮ menu in the browser's corner.
Install.menuStep2: Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
Install.inApp: You can't pin it from inside WhatsApp. Copy the link, open it in Chrome or Safari and tap "Pin to home screen" again.
